system.description:
Sometimes, you don't have time for decorum as you attach breaching tags to your weapon and Fire it at a structure or construct.

Select a Construct or Structure within range, make a ranged Taijutsu attack, dealing you [Weapons damage] + 6d6 Fire and 6d6 Bludgeoning on hit. Constructs and Structures are vulnerable to this Jutsu’s damage.

Chain 2: You can choose to instead target a creature with this jutsu. If you do, reduce the bonus damage dealt to 2d6 for each damage type.

At Higher Ranks: For each rank you cast this Jutsu above B rank, increase the cost of the Jutsu by 3, and the damage by 1d6 of each type.
